name: Assessments: no report
description: Every morning: a task for the response lead for each assessment completed 14 days ago or more with no report or report link. One open task per assessment at a time.

routes.name: no_report
routes.description: Completed, no report after 14 days: the A&A Cell asks the organisation for it (or why there isn't one).
routes.fixedNote: Completed 14 days ago or more, and no report or link to one: a task to ask the organisation for it.

routes.name: has_report
routes.description: It has a report (or a link to one): nothing to do.

name: Assessments: start passed
description: Every morning: a task for the response lead for each planned assessment whose start date has passed: has it started, moved or been dropped?

routes.name: start_passed
routes.description: Still planned after its start date: ask the organisation whether it started.
routes.fixedNote: Still planned, though its start date has passed: a task to ask the organisation for its status.

name: Assessments: overlap
description: When an assessment is found to overlap another organisation's (the same sector, place and time): a task for the response lead to put the organisations in touch.

routes.name: overlap
routes.description: Overlaps another organisation's assessment: the A&A Cell puts them in touch (harmonise, or join up).
routes.fixedNote: Another organisation is assessing a sector this one has, in the same places, at the same time: a task to put them in touch.
